author: Adam Conover
description:
I'M ON TOUR: http://adamconover.net
A year ago, I went through an incredibly difficult breakup. As it was happening, I went on stage, and just started talking about what was happening to me. That material turned into the most raw and personal hour of comedy I've ever done. I directed this special myself at the Den Theatre in Chicago, and I'm so happy to share it with all of you for free on YouTube.

Thank you to the Patreon supporters who made this special possible: http://patreon.com/adamconover

In his hilariously raw and unexpectedly vulnerable new special Big Divorce Energy, Adam Conover talks sex and self-discovery, dating after divorce and why straight men are the most repressed people in America.
title: Adam Conover: Big Divorce Energy | Full Standup Special
